primary.title: Bengaluru tenant gets only ₹19,000 of ₹1.3 lakh security deposit: What does the law say on arbitrary deductions
primary.summary: A security deposit is the tenant's property, held in trust by the landlord against proven dues, and cannot be arbitrarily deducted under Indian tenancy law and property jurisprudence.
